fact: Per Botswana Daily News (BOPA) on 25 Feb 2026, the Cyber Security Act passed last year was signed into law and was still waiting to commence by April 2026, so it was not yet in force; it sets up a National Cybersecurity Authority.

Parliament passed the Cybersecurity Bill, 2025 under a certificate of urgency presented by the Minister of Communications and Innovation on 14 August 2025 (reported 17 Aug 2025); it was not yet enacted.

ITWeb reports the ICT minister said the Cybersecurity Act was passed in November 2025 and establishes a National Cybersecurity Authority; it gives no commencement date or statement that the Act is in force.
Botswana Daily News reports the communications minister said the Cyber Security Act was expected to come into force in April (2026), so it was not yet in force on 9 March 2026.

The Cybersecurity Act, 2025 (Act No. 21 of 2025) was assented to on 5 November 2025 and gazetted on 11 November 2025; its commencement is on a date the Minister appoints by Order, shown as on notice, and it repeals and replaces the Cybercrime and Computer Related Crimes Act 2018.
The notice describes a draft Cybersecurity Bill that would enact a Cybersecurity Act and set up a cybersecurity institutional framework, with public consultation on 20 June 2025.
Botswana Gazette reports the Attorney General's savingram questioning provisions of the Ministry of Communications and Innovation's draft cybersecurity bill.
